property_summary: When the fallback is triggered and block.number is divisible by 15, the contract's entire balance must be transferred to the sender, leaving the contract with 0 balance; the mutant violates this by sending 0 instead.
change_summary: Replace payable(msg.sender).transfer(address(this).balance) with payable(msg.sender).transfer(0), so no ether is transferred even when the condition is met.
